title: Pin/verify checksum for renode-latest.linux-portable.tar.gz download in docs workflow
description: Review finding (z3jb round): docs/renode-workflow.md:456 fetches https://builds.renode.io/renode-latest.linux-portable.tar.gz with no checksum verification — a floating dependency surface larger than the uv pin fixed in z3jb. Options: pin a specific Renode version tarball with sha256, or verify against a published checksum. Pre-existing, unrelated to z3jb's one-line change; tracked so it is not lost.
